projects.title: Rashtriya Swasthya Sangathan
projects.subtitle: NGO Donation & Outreach Platform
projects.description: This NGO runs blood donation camps, mobile health clinics, old-age home support, and medical aid for underprivileged communities across India — but had no way for donors or volunteers to find them online. We built a full donation and outreach website: volunteer and donor sign-up, a cause-based donation flow, a news and events section, a photo gallery, and their impact numbers, all in one place. People can now find the organization, understand what they do, and give — without the NGO needing a developer on staff.

projects.title: SA Ethics Biotech
projects.subtitle: Concept Build — Certified Medical Device Manufacturer
projects.description: SA Ethics Biotech is an ISO 9001:2015 & ISO 13485:2016 certified manufacturer and importer/exporter of medical devices and blood bank equipment, based in Delhi and Kanpur. After delivering the Rashtriya Swasthya Sangathan project, we built this corporate site on spec — unpaid, unsolicited — to show what a site matching their certifications and B2B credibility could look like. It was never adopted: not live on their actual domain, not paid for, not a client engagement. Shown here as design work, honestly labeled, not as a delivered project.

about.label: Who We Are
about.title: We build software
paragraphs: We partner with ambitious businesses to design and build digital products that are thoughtful, reliable, and built to grow.
From the first idea to a production-ready product, we bring product thinking and engineering together — creating experiences that feel simple on the surface and work beautifully underneath.
We believe great software doesn't need unnecessary complexity. It needs clear thinking, strong engineering, and a genuine understanding of the people using it.
**Thoughtful design. Solid engineering. Technology that moves your business forward.**

aboutPage.heading: Working With Us
paragraphs: Every project starts with a discovery call, not a sales pitch — we want to understand what you actually need before talking about cost. From there you get a written, fixed-scope proposal, so the number you agree to is the number you pay.

Arpit Dwivedi, the founder, stays hands-on through the whole build — there's no handoff between an account manager and whoever actually writes the code. If you have a question mid-project, you're talking to the person building it.
We don't disappear after launch. Fixes, small updates, and follow-up work are part of how we work, not a separate retainer you have to negotiate into existence.

faq.question: Do you build the backend, or just the frontend?
faq.answer: Both — the backend is the part most agencies quietly hand off to a subcontractor. It's built in-house here.

faq.question: What does "backend and identity engineering" actually mean, day to day?
faq.answer: Authentication, session and token handling, data modeling, API design — the parts of an application that don't show up in a demo but decide whether it holds up under real users.

faq.question: Do you work with pre-funding or early-stage startups?
faq.answer: Yes — most of what gets built here is for teams that need something built properly on a limited budget, not a polished enterprise engagement.

faq.question: Can you join an existing codebase, or does it have to be a new build?
faq.answer: Either. That's exactly what a discovery call is for — the honest answer depends on the state of what's already there.

faq.question: Is this invoice generator really free?
faq.answer: Yes — creating, downloading, and saving invoices is completely free, with no account or signup required.

faq.question: Where are my invoices stored?
faq.answer: In your browser's local storage, on your own device. Nothing is uploaded to a server, which also means invoices won't appear if you switch browsers or devices.

faq.question: Can I add my logo and business details once and reuse them?
faq.answer: Yes — fill in your logo, address, currency, notes, and terms, then click "Save as default." Every new invoice you create will start pre-filled with those details.

faq.question: Does the PDF look the same as what I see on screen?
faq.answer: Yes — the PDF is generated directly from your invoice data, not a screenshot, so text stays sharp and the layout matches what you filled in.

faq.question: Can I edit an invoice after saving it?
faq.answer: Yes — open "History," click any saved invoice to load it back into the editor, make your changes, and save again.

howItWorksSteps: Pick a content type — a web page, a contact card, plain text, an SMS, an email, a phone number, an app link, or a social profile.
Fill in the fields for that type — the QR code on the right updates as you type.
Customize the colors and error correction if you like, then download it as a PNG or SVG, or copy it straight to your clipboard.
features: Nine content types in one tool — URL, PDF link, multi-URL, contact card, plain text, app link, SMS, email, and phone
Live preview that updates as you type, with adjustable error correction
Foreground and background color customization with quick presets
Download as a high-resolution PNG or a scalable SVG, or copy the image directly
Runs entirely in your browser — nothing you enter is ever uploaded or stored
useCases: Printed menus, posters, or packaging that link to a web page or PDF

Store signage that opens WhatsApp, dials your phone, or pre-fills an email

advantages: No account or signup needed to generate or download a QR code
Nothing you type is ever sent to a server — the code is built in your browser

limitations: There's no save/history for generated QR codes — download the ones you need before leaving the page
"Multi-URL" redirects to a random link on each scan rather than tracking scan counts or letting you edit the destinations after printing (that needs a backend, which this tool doesn't have)
A QR code can't be edited once printed — if the destination link changes, you'll need to generate and reprint a new code

faq.question: Is this QR code generator really free?
faq.answer: Yes — generating, customizing, and downloading QR codes is completely free, with no account, signup, or watermark.

faq.question: Do my QR codes expire?
faq.answer: No. Every QR code this tool makes (except Multi-URL and dual-platform App links) encodes your content directly, so it works for as long as the destination link or content is valid — there's no subscription or expiry tied to this tool.

faq.question: What's the difference between PNG and SVG?
faq.answer: PNG is a fixed-resolution image, good for most uses. SVG is a vector file that stays sharp at any size, which is better if you're printing the code very large, like on a poster or banner.

faq.question: Will the QR code still scan if I change the colors?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as there's enough contrast between the foreground and background colors. Very light foreground colors or low-contrast combinations can make a QR code harder for some scanners to read — the built-in presets are chosen to scan reliably.

faq.question: How does the "Multi-URL" option work without a server?
faq.answer: The QR code encodes a link back to this site with your list of URLs built into the link itself. When someone scans it, their browser picks one of your URLs at random and redirects — no database or account needed on our end.

faq.question: Can I upload a PDF to be hosted here?
faq.answer: No — this tool doesn't store or host files. For the PDF type, paste a link to a PDF you've already uploaded elsewhere (Google Drive, Dropbox, your own website), and the QR code will point straight to it.
